consolidation_findings.finding: GXEON-AI source lineage is deployed into multiple Vercel projects and more than one connected account.
consolidation_findings.decision: Treat these as deployment shells of one source lineage until product identity proves otherwise.

consolidation_findings.finding: XPeX Academy has multiple legacy Vercel projects with canceled production deployments.
consolidation_findings.decision: Do not mark Academy broken solely from Vercel. Deployment metadata states the legacy Vercel path was decommissioned in favor of GitHub + Firebase + Railway; canonical runtime still requires provider corroboration.

consolidation_findings.finding: Several historical XPeX dashboards/task-agent projects are duplicated by suffix or generated shell.
consolidation_findings.decision: Do not promote duplicate shells into the public product portfolio.

consolidation_findings.finding: Some READY projects resolve to source organizations not currently covered by the connected GitHub installation.
consolidation_findings.decision: Keep them as provider-evidenced portfolio candidates until source ownership/lineage is independently correlated.

rule: Provider inventory is discovery evidence. It does not by itself prove canonical identity, ownership, commercial readiness or external certification.
privacy_note: Connected account identities are intentionally omitted from the public audit summary; only portfolio-relevant scope labels and counts are published.
